events.title: Indian Shares Hit Eight-month High Amid Sharp Fall In Oil Prices
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Wednesday to hit an eight-month high, with investor sentiment boosted by continued foreign fund inflows, a moderation of the AI trade, and a retreat in crude oil prices to two-month lows on hopes for a de-escalation in the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

events.title: Gold Steadies After Sharp Selloff
events.description: Gold prices were a tad higher on Wednesday, after having tumbled in the previous session on concerns over rising inflationary pressures and expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

events.title: Oil Prices Rebound From Two-month Low
events.description: Oil prices traded higher on Wednesday after a two-day decline as fresh tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz raised concerns over global oil supplies.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher As AI Concerns Ease
events.description: European stocks surged toward a fresh record on Wednesday, with investor sentiment underpinned by steadier oil prices, solid corporate earnings and renewed enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: Asian Shares Mostly Higher As Chip Stocks Extend Rebound
events.description: Asian stocks ended mostly higher on Wednesday, even as stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs data bolstered the case for further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes over the coming months.

events.title: European Shares Poised For Firm Start As Inflation, AI Worries Ease
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Wednesday as softer oil prices eased inflation concerns and cloud-computing company CoreWeave said it would become profitable on an adjusted basis in the first half of 2028, easing fears about its debt-laden business.

events.title: Indian Shares Climb Amid Easing Oil Prices
events.description: Indian shares opened on a buoyant note on Wednesday after Brent crude prices hit close to ten-week lows overnight on signs of easing tensions between the U.S. and Iran, and reports suggesting that Middle Eastern oil shipments have nearly returned to prewar levels despite ongoing attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Australian Market Swings To Modest Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is swinging to modest gains in mid-market moves on Wednesday after opening in the red, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving up to near the 9,150 level, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with gains in energy, financial and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in mining stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mixed on Wednesday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as hotter-than-expected US inflation data led to renewed concerns about the outlook for interest rates. Meanwhile, crude oil prices declined as concerns of U.S.-Iran re-escalation faded after U.S. President Donald Trump agreed to maintain a status quo in the Middle East crisis.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening Higher As Oil Holds Near Two-month Lows
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Wednesday as investors keep an eye on falling crude oil prices and soaring U.S. Treasury yields.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Open In The Red On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked higher in back-to-back sessions, advancing more than 30 points or 2.1 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,500-point plateau although it may open to the downside on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading notably higher on Wednesday, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 60,900 level, with gains in financial and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in automaker stocks.

events.title: Lower Open Tipped For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, advancing almost 220 points or 4.5 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,125-point plateau although it's due for consolidation on Wednesday.
